mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and consumer price inflation signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production above 105.0 index points signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, driving higher earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1600.0 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and residential investment, boosting economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1600.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 152,000 thousand persons signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (excluding autos) above 680,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 index points signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
